title: Hunts FH-049T: Enforce Hunt claim prerequisites across concurrent progress writes
detail: Requires FH-010 and FH-014S. Add p_expected_progress_count integer default null to hunt_claim_apply. Under the existing run lock, compare it to the total number of hunt_progress rows for that run and return stale_progress before any credit or side effects on mismatch. Keep old callers compatible through the null default, replace the old signature, and grant execution to service_role only. Use one complete progress snapshot for the total count and graph evaluation of credited rows. The adapter sends that count and rereads and reevaluates once on stale_progress before retrying. Prove a concurrent progress change cannot credit against the stale snapshot, that the retry is bounded, and that null retains the prior behavior. Order: registration PR, migration PR, Daniel applies and records the SQL in Frequency Community, then the adapter PR. This gates HUNTS_CLAIMS_ENABLED in production, FH-042 exclusive branches, and any real-value Hunt reward. Before release, record pgTAP and exact-head workflow_dispatch db-tests, real API acceptance, the approved apply sequence, and Frequency Community ledger parity.
